backTop.title: BackTop — Back to Top
backTop.subtitle: A back-to-top button shown while the page is scrolling, supporting rounded-square/circular shapes, custom icons, and hint text.
backTop.basicDesc: After scrolling the page, a back-to-top button appears in the bottom-right corner. Tap it to smoothly scroll back to the top.
backTop.shapeDesc: shape="square" is a soft square with a small radius (4px, default), shape="circle" is a perfect circle. For a true sharp corner, inline border-radius: 0 via custom-style.
backTop.tipsDesc: Use the tips property to set the hint text below the button.
backTop.positionDesc: Adjust the button position with the bottom and right properties, in px units.
backTop.iconStyleDesc: Use the icon-style property to customize the icon's color and size.
backTop.scrollTestDesc: Scroll down the page to observe the show/hide animation of the back-to-top button.

empty.title: Empty — Empty State
empty.subtitle: A hint for empty content states, with a dozen built-in scenario icons.
empty.basicDesc: Set the hint text with the text property and the icon type with the mode property.
empty.iconsDesc: Use the mode parameter to pick different scenario icons.
empty.colorDesc: Customize colors with color/icon-color and sizes with icon-size/font-size.
empty.srcDesc: Pass an image path via src; the mode parameter will then be ignored.
empty.slotDesc: Use the bottom slot to add custom content at the bottom of the component.

icon.title: Icon — Icons
icon.subtitle: A font-based icon set covering most common scenarios.
icon.customDesc: Customize icon size and color via size and color props
icon.boldDesc: Control whether the icon is bold via the bold prop
icon.typeDesc: Set the theme color via type: primary, success, error, warning, info; a custom color prop takes precedence when set
icon.imgDesc: Passing an image URL to name renders an image icon; combine with width, height and imgMode
icon.prefixDesc: Use a custom font icon library via custom-prefix
icon.topDesc: Adjust the icon's vertical position via top to fix alignment issues in some scenarios
icon.gridDesc: Tap any icon to copy its name for use in your project.

noNetwork.title: NoNetwork — No Network
noNetwork.subtitle: The component automatically shows a no-network notice when flight mode is on or the network is disconnected.
noNetwork.basicDesc: No configuration needed — just import it. It appears automatically when flight mode is on or the network is disconnected.

safeBottom.title: SafeBottom — Bottom Safe Area
safeBottom.subtitle: Adapts the bottom safe area for devices with a home indicator bar, such as iPhone X.
safeBottom.basicDesc: A placeholder component for the bottom safe area that automatically adapts to the safe-area height.
safeBottom.customStyleDesc: Use custom-style to set custom styles such as the background color.
safeBottom.customClassDesc: Use custom-class to add a custom style class.

tag.title: Tag — Tags
tag.subtitle: For marking and selection, supporting multiple types, sizes, shapes, and a closable mode.
tag.basicDesc: Set the theme type with the type parameter; it defaults to primary.
tag.modeDesc: dark (dark background), light (light background), plain (white background).
tag.shapeDesc: square (small radius 3px, default), round (capsule), roundLeft (rounded left), roundRight (rounded right).
tag.colorDesc: Customize the text, background, and border colors with color, bg-color, and border-color.
tag.closeableDesc: Set closeable to true; tapping the close button triggers the close event.
tag.disabledDesc: Set disabled to true to gray out the tag and make it unclickable.
tag.slotDesc: Use the default slot to customize the tag content.

divider.title: Divider
divider.subtitle: A divider that separates content, commonly used at the bottom of a page to indicate there is no more content.
divider.dividerText: The long river falls with the setting sun

line.title: Line
line.subtitle: Displays a line to separate content blocks, supporting both horizontal and vertical modes, and can be set to 0.5px.

section.title: Section Title
section.subtitle: Used for scenarios with lots of categorized information where only a portion is shown to guide users to view more.

badge.title: Badge
badge.subtitle: Displays numeric or dot notifications at the top-right corner of avatars, icons, etc.
badge.wrapDesc: Put content in the default slot; the badge has a built-in anchor, auto-placed at the top-right, zero host config
badge.singleDesc: No content; used as a standalone badge overlaid on the host's relatively positioned top-right

button.title: Button
button.subtitle: A secondary wrapper based on the uni-app button, with more theme colors and optional click ripple effects.
button.basicDesc: Default theme by default; click triggers the click event.
button.basicText: Mountains and rivers, wind and moon
button.typeDesc: Supports default / primary / success / error / warning / info themes.
button.shapeDesc: shape="square" for a small radius (4px, default), shape="round" for a capsule, shape="circle" for a perfect circle (requires equal width and height). Pass :border-radius="0" for a true sharp corner.
button.radiusDesc: border-radius takes precedence over the shape presets, letting you set any corner value (in px); pass 0 for a true sharp corner.
button.plainDesc: When plain=true, the background is transparent, showing only the border and text.
button.rippleDesc: When ripple=true, enables click ripple effect; ripple-bg-color customizes the ripple color.
button.hairLineDesc: When hair-line=false, the hairline border is disabled and a bold border is used.
button.loadingDesc: When loading=true, shows a loading state and the button is not clickable.
button.disabledDesc: When disabled=true, the button is grayed out and not clickable; solid colored types (primary/success/error/warning) hide the border, while default/info/hollow keep the hairline border.
button.iconDesc: icon specifies the icon name; icon-size controls the size; icon-color controls the color (defaults to the text color).
button.slotDesc: Plain text via text or default slot (auto-colored); rich custom content via content slot, set color on inner text manually (App does not inherit styles).
button.blockDesc: When block=true, the button fills the entire row width.
button.customStyleDesc: Override the button style via custom-style. In fully-custom scenarios, press feedback (hover/pressing) is also handed over to the custom style; the component does not interfere.
button.throttleDesc: throttle-time sets the click throttle interval in ms; taps within the interval fire only once.

overlay.title: Overlay — Mask Layer
overlay.subtitle: A full-screen fixed mask that can be used standalone and also backs the Popup mask; visibility is driven by v-if node creation plus a class-channel fade.
overlay.countDesc: Only two counters are kept: Open counts component opened (fade-in finished), Close counts closed (fade-out finished, node unmounted); all three overlay instances share one pair. If the counters climb while the mask stays invisible, the event channel is intact and the visibility channel is broken.
overlay.basicDesc: v-model:show controls visibility; tapping the mask closes it.
overlay.durationDesc: duration sets the fade in/out length in milliseconds; a new value takes effect on the next open.
overlay.customDesc: bg-color overrides the default translucent black and z-index sets the stacking order (empty falls back to the global mask zIndex); this demo is fully controlled, the page decides when to close.
overlay.contentDesc: The default slot holds overlay content; @click.stop on the content box keeps taps from closing the overlay.
overlay.clickableDesc: With close-on-click-overlay=false a mask tap only emits click and never writes back show; close it with the close cell inside the content.
overlay.clickableText: Tapping the mask does not close it
overlay.stressDesc: Flips visibility every 500ms for 6 rounds to reproduce the occasional mask-only / transparent-mask failures; each round should add 1 to both counters, so look for rounds that never finished.

mask.title: Mask — Overlay
mask.subtitle: Creates an overlay layer to emphasize specific page elements and block interaction with the content beneath, commonly used in popup scenarios.
mask.basicDesc: Tap the button to show the mask; tap the mask area to close it.
mask.zoomDesc: When zoom=true the content animates with a scale (0.8 → 1 on open, back to 0.8 on close; the mask background does not scale); when zoom=false there is no zoom.
mask.contentDesc: Fill custom content inside the mask via the default slot; tapping the content will not close the mask.
mask.durationDesc: Set the show/hide animation duration of the mask in milliseconds via duration.
mask.clickableDesc: When mask-click-able=false, tapping the mask will not close it; close it via the button inside the content instead.

transition.title: Transition
transition.subtitle: Unified enter/leave animation wrapper based on CSS transition (no @keyframes dependency), consistent across H5, mini-program and App.
transition.basicDesc: show controls visibility with a fade transition by default; the component only handles the transition while content sizing is up to you.
transition.cardText: Any content inside the default slot can be transitioned
transition.presetDesc: Seven presets: fade / slide-up / slide-down / slide-left / slide-right / zoom-in / zoom-out. Tap to switch and replay instantly.
transition.durationDesc: duration sets the enter/leave transition length in milliseconds.
transition.timingDesc: timing-function customizes the easing curve; the bounce curve adds elasticity to the animation.
transition.delayDesc: delay adds waiting time before the transition starts, applied to both enter and leave; completion events fire after duration + delay.
transition.appearDesc: When appear=true the enter animation plays on first mount; remount is required to reproduce it (outer v-if rebuild).
transition.appearLabel: Play enter animation on first render
transition.eventDesc: Full lifecycle hooks: before-enter / enter / after-enter / enter-cancelled / before-leave / leave / after-leave / leave-cancelled.
transition.eventEmpty: Toggle visibility to see event callbacks
transition.customDesc: custom-class extends the root class; custom-style applies inline styles.

loading.title: Loading
loading.subtitle: Displays a loading animation supporting circle and flower modes, commonly used in load-more, switch, and other loading states.
loading.basicDesc: Circle mode by default, rotating automatically.
loading.modeDesc: mode="circle" is the circle mode; mode="flower" is the flower mode.
loading.colorDesc: color only works for circle mode, setting the color of the active area.
loading.sizeDesc: Set the size of the loading icon in px via size.
loading.showDesc: When show=false the loading animation is hidden.

switch.title: Switch
switch.subtitle: A switch for toggling between two states, supporting custom colors, sizes, and loading/disabled states.
switch.basicDesc: Bind the switch state with v-model, true/false by default.
switch.valueDesc: Customize the switch values with active-value and inactive-value.
switch.colorDesc: Set the background color when active via active-color.
switch.sizeDesc: Supports small(22px), default(28px), large(34px) presets and custom values (track height).
switch.loadingDesc: When loading=true the loading animation is shown and the switch is not operable.
switch.disabledDesc: When disabled=true the switch is not operable and shown semi-transparent.

skeleton.title: Skeleton
skeleton.subtitle: Shows gray placeholder blocks to preview the page structure while remote data is loading.
skeleton.basicDesc: Shows title and paragraph placeholders by default when loading=true.
skeleton.rowsDesc: Set the number of paragraph placeholder rows via rows.
skeleton.widthDesc: rows-width / rows-height support arrays per row; title-width / title-height set the title size.
skeleton.avatarDesc: avatar=true shows an avatar placeholder; avatar-shape supports circle / square.
skeleton.animateDesc: animate controls the shimmer sweep; toggle the button to compare on/off.
skeleton.sceneDesc: Simulates message/article list skeletons; each card shimmers independently for a realistic look.
skeleton.loadingDesc: loading=false hides the skeleton and shows real content; the skeleton structure matches the real content one-to-one and replaces it in place.
skeleton.loadingLine1: Rich components covering various needs across development, cross-platform and ready to use.
skeleton.loadingLine2: Fully-featured components with customizable styles and global theme.
skeleton.loadingLine3: Copy example code with one click to integrate into your project.

input.title: Input
input.subtitle: No border or style by default; works with form components for validation, input, and dropdown selection.
input.basicDesc: Bind the input value with v-model; border shows the outline.
input.typeDesc: Supports text / number / password / textarea and more.
input.alignDesc: Set the text alignment of the input via input-align.
input.sizeDesc: Supports small / default / large presets and custom values (px).
input.fontSizeDesc: Set the font size via font-size, which takes precedence over the size preset.
input.borderDesc: Customize the border color via border-color; requires border to be enabled.
input.passwordDesc: type=password shows an eye icon by default; click to toggle plain text.
input.clearDesc: When clearable=true, a clear icon appears after typing; click to clear.
input.countDesc: When type=textarea and count=true, word count shows at the bottom right.
input.stateDesc: disabled blocks input; readonly prevents editing but still triggers the click event.
input.heightDesc: Set the input height via height in px; auto for automatic height.
input.prefixDesc: Use the prefix slot to place an icon or custom content before the input area, common for amount, unit fields.
input.focusDesc: When focus=true the input gains focus on load; pairs with selection-start/selection-end to select text.
input.autoHeightDesc: When type=textarea and auto-height=true, the input area grows with content.
input.trimDesc: When trim=true, leading and trailing whitespace is removed from input.
input.validateStateDesc: When validate-state=true the border turns red for validation failure feedback.

form.title: Form
form.subtitle: Works with input and other components, supports validation rules for form validation and reset.
form.basicDesc: Configure rules via rules, validate all fields with validate(), and reset with resetFields().
form.labelPositionDesc: When label-position is set to top, the label is displayed above the input.
form.labelWidthDesc: Customize the label width via label-width, in px.
form.requiredDesc: required shows the asterisk on the left; combined with the required rule for required validation.
form.customDesc: Use validator functions for custom validation, which can be async; return true to pass, or a string as the error message.
form.allComponentsDesc: A collection of commonly used form components, covering multiline text, option selection, numeric adjustment and selection/query scenarios.
form.extraPlaceholder: Please enter specialty, this is a nested validation extra.strong
form.agreement: I have read and agree to the User Agreement
form.agreeFirst: Please agree to the agreement first

countDown.title: CountDown
countDown.subtitle: Commonly used in countdown scenarios, giving users a clear sense of time through changing numbers.
countDown.basicDesc: Separated by colons by default, starts counting down automatically, and displays down to the second.
countDown.zhSepDesc: When separator is set to zh, days/hours/minutes/seconds are separated in Chinese; separator-color customizes the separator color.
countDown.hideDaysDesc: When show-days is false, the days portion is converted into hours.
countDown.customStyleDesc: Customize the number style via font-size / color; separator-size controls the separator size.
countDown.borderDesc: show-border displays a border around the numbers, height sets the number box size, and border-color customizes the border color.
countDown.unitsDesc: Control the visibility of each time unit via show-hours / show-minutes / show-seconds.
countDown.zeroDayDesc: When hide-zero-day is true, the day field is hidden when the day is 0.
countDown.msDesc: When millisecond is true, the countdown refreshes at millisecond granularity.
countDown.controlDesc: When autoplay is false, the countdown does not start automatically; call the start / end methods manually.

countTo.title: CountTo
countTo.subtitle: A rolling number display with easing when the number increases to a certain value.
countTo.basicDesc: By default it rolls from 0 to end-val, starts automatically, and ends with easing.
countTo.customRangeDesc: Specify the start and end values via start-val / end-val; countdown is also supported.
countTo.separatorDesc: Use separator to add a thousands separator for numbers above four digits.
countTo.decimalDesc: Control the number of decimal places via decimals; decimal customizes the decimal point symbol.
countTo.customStyleDesc: Customize the text style via color / font-size / bold.
countTo.noEasingDesc: With use-easing=false, the number grows at a constant rate with no easing at the end.
countTo.controlDesc: Control the rolling duration (ms) via duration, whether to start automatically via autoplay, or trigger start manually.

circleProgress.title: CircleProgress
circleProgress.subtitle: Shows the current progress of an operation or task as a circular progress ring.
circleProgress.basicDesc: Uses the success theme color by default, with the percentage displayed inside.
circleProgress.typeDesc: Configure primary/success/warning/error/info themes via type; once set, active-color becomes ineffective.
circleProgress.sizeDesc: Set the ring width via width and border width via border-width, in px.
circleProgress.dynamicDesc: Percent changes trigger an animated update; use the buttons to increase or decrease.
circleProgress.customDesc: Customize the active and inactive colors via active-color / inactive-color, the background via bg-color, and the animation duration via duration.

gap.title: Gap
gap.subtitle: Uses gray blocks to separate content blocks, keeping the style consistent and reducing workload.

lineProgress.title: LineProgress
lineProgress.subtitle: Shows the current progress of an operation or task as a linear progress bar.
lineProgress.basicDesc: Uses the success theme color by default, displays the percentage inside, with semicircular ends.
lineProgress.themeDesc: Configure primary/error/warning/info themes via type; once set, active-color becomes ineffective.
lineProgress.customColorDesc: Customize the active and inactive colors via active-color / inactive-color.
lineProgress.customHeightDesc: Set the progress bar height via height, in px.
lineProgress.hidePercentDesc: Hide the internal percentage text via show-percent=false, or use a custom slot.
lineProgress.stripedDesc: striped shows stripes, and striped-active makes the stripes scroll dynamically.
lineProgress.roundDesc: shape="round" gives capsule ends (default); shape="square" gives a flat end with a 3px small radius.

link.title: Link
link.subtitle: Displays links with support for custom colors, sizes, underlines, etc., adapted for multi-platform navigation.
link.basicDesc: Clicking the link opens the built-in browser on App, copies to the clipboard on Mini Program, and opens a new window on H5.
link.linkText: Click here to visit the uView website
link.colorDesc: Set the text color via the color property; defaults to the theme content color.
link.fontSizeDesc: Set the font size via the font-size property, in px.
link.underlineDesc: Set under-line to true to show an underline below the link.
link.lineColorDesc: Set line-color to change the underline color independently; it takes priority over color.
link.clickDesc: Set default-click to false so that clicking only triggers the click event without performing the default navigation.
link.clickText: Click to trigger the click event

noticeBar.title: NoticeBar
noticeBar.subtitle: Scrolls to display notifications, announcements, etc., supporting both horizontal and vertical scrolling.
noticeBar.hBasicDesc: Configure the scrolling content via the list array; defaults to the warning theme and scrolls horizontally.
noticeBar.hIconDesc: volume-icon is the speaker on the left, more-icon is the arrow on the right, and close-icon is the close button on the right.
noticeBar.hColorDesc: Customize the text/icon color and background color via color/bg-color.
noticeBar.hControlDesc: autoplay controls auto-play, play-state controls play/pause, and speed controls the speed.
noticeBar.vBasicDesc: Configure the scrolling content via the list array; defaults to the warning theme and scrolls vertically.
noticeBar.vIconDesc: volume-icon is the speaker on the left, more-icon is the arrow on the right, and close-icon is the close button on the right.
noticeBar.vColorDesc: Customize the text/icon color and background color via color/bg-color.
noticeBar.vControlDesc: play-state controls play/pause, duration controls the scroll cycle, and disable-touch prevents manual swiping.
noticeBar.listItem1: Cold rain falls over the river at night, entering Wu
noticeBar.listItem2: At dawn I see off a guest, alone at Chu Mountain
noticeBar.listItem3: If relatives and friends in Luoyang ask about me
noticeBar.listItem4: Tell them my heart is as pure as ice in a jade vase
noticeBar.toastEnd: Reached the end of the scroll

tabbar.title: TabBar
tabbar.subtitle: A bottom navigation bar supporting icon-only, icon+text, raised button, badges, and custom styles.
tabbar.selectSceneDesc: The bottom tab bar is fixed at the bottom of the screen; switch scenes below to view different configurations.
tabbar.iconHint: Each tab only configures iconPath / selectedIconPath without text, to verify that icons are horizontally centered on App.
tabbar.iconTextHint: A standard tab bar with the icon above and text below; the gap between icon and text is controlled by gap.
tabbar.midButtonHint: Set mid-button to enable the raised button, combined with border-top to show the top border.
tabbar.badgeHint: Use count to show a numeric badge and isDot to show a dot badge.
tabbar.customHint: Customize the active and inactive colors via active-color / inactive-color; border-top controls the top border.

text.title: Text
text.subtitle: Integrates common text features including status, phone calls, date formatting, asterisk masking, and hyperlinks.
text.basicText: I spent ten years of my youth to keep our final appointment
text.blockText: This is block text that fills the entire line
text.lines1Text: This is a very, very long piece of text that gets truncated with an ellipsis when it exceeds one line, used to test single-line clamping.
text.lines2Text: This is a very, very long piece of text that gets truncated with an ellipsis when it exceeds two lines, used to test multi-line clamping; more content is added here to push it past two lines.
text.phoneDesc: First line masks the number with format="encrypt"; second line calls directly via call
text.spacingDesc: margin and line-height accept numbers and auto-append units
text.spacingText: Text with custom margin and line height
text.layoutDesc: block + align=center centers horizontally; word-wrap=break-word wraps long text
text.layoutText: This is a long piece of text demonstrating word-wrap=break-word wrapping when it exceeds the container width.
text.styleObjDesc: iconStyle controls the icon font size, textStyle controls the text style
text.openTypeDesc: With open-type the text renders as a native button on WeChat Mini Program and triggers capability callbacks

addUnit.title: addUnit Unit Conversion
addUnit.subtitle: Add a unit to numbers, defaults to px
addUnit.strTitle: Passing a string (with an existing unit)

color.title: color Color Configuration
color.subtitle: Theme color constants, consistent with the SCSS variable values

debounce.title: debounce Debounce
debounce.subtitle: Within a period, only the last operation executes the function after wait milliseconds
debounce.usageFunc: • func: the callback function to execute
debounce.usageImmediate: • immediate: whether to execute immediately, default false
debounce.usageReturn: • returns: the debounced function; keep a reference to it

deepClone.title: deepClone Deep Clone
deepClone.subtitle: Deeply clone an object or array, creating a fully independent copy
deepClone.usageObj: • obj: the object or array to clone
deepClone.usageSupport: • supports: Object, Array, Date, RegExp, Map, Set

deepMerge.title: deepMerge Deep Merge
deepMerge.subtitle: Deeply merge two objects; the source object's properties are recursively merged into the target
deepMerge.usageReturn: • returns: a new merged object (the original objects are not modified)
deepMerge.usageNote: • note: arrays are fully replaced, not merged

test.title: test Type Detection
test.subtitle: Provides various data type validation methods

throttle.title: throttle Throttle
throttle.subtitle: Within a period, it can only be triggered once
throttle.usageFunc: • func: the callback function to execute
throttle.usageImmediate: • immediate: whether to execute immediately, default true
throttle.usageReturn: • returns: the throttled function; keep a reference to it

toStyle.title: toStyle Style Conversion
toStyle.subtitle: Convert a style object or style string into a CSS string
toStyle.previewText: This is a piece of text
toStyle.mergeDesc1: Merge two objects (manually merged before passing)
toStyle.mergeDesc2: The later value overrides the earlier one (color override)

trim.title: trim Remove Whitespace
trim.subtitle: Remove whitespace from both ends or all whitespace in a string

useDebounce.title: useDebounce Debounce Hook
useDebounce.subtitle: Create a debounce function using a Hook, with a customizable delay
useDebounce.usageTime: • time: delay; pass null to use the default

useLocale.title: useLocale Internationalization
useLocale.subtitle: Provides multi-language translation, language switching, and more
useLocale.originalText: Original text: Files in the {ext} format are not allowed

useThrottle.title: useThrottle Throttle Hook
useThrottle.subtitle: Create a throttle function using a Hook to control execution frequency
useThrottle.defaultBtn: Click to trigger throttle (once per second)
useThrottle.usageTime: • time: interval; pass null to use the default

card.title: Card
card.subtitle: Card component is commonly used for multiple list items with a consistent style, supporting head/body/foot slots, rounded corners, shadow and border.
card.basicDesc: Configure the head title and sub-title via title / sub-title, and fill the body with the default slot.
card.basicBodyText: The peony painted on the bottle is like your first makeup, the sandalwood fragrance seeps through the window.
card.thumbDesc: Show a thumbnail on the left of the title via thumb, and control whether it is circular via thumb-circle.
card.thumbBodyText: The glaze renders the beauty of the painting, and your smile is like a budding flower.
card.slotDesc: Customize the head and foot via head / foot slots, fill the body via the default slot, and compose a feed-style card with text and images.
card.slotPostText: Tonight we share a new palette with a warm orange gradient, ideal for e-commerce promotion scenes and more readable with dark text.
card.shadowDesc: Add an outer shadow to the card via box-shadow, as a string.
card.radiusDesc: Set the overall border radius of the card via border-radius, in px.
card.radiusBodyText: Adjust the card radius via the border-radius property; 0 means square corners.
card.borderDesc: Control whether to show the card outer border via border.
card.borderBodyText: Show the card outer border via the border property; it works best with rounded corners.
card.fullDesc: When full=true, the card leaves no gap on both sides, with left/right margin of 0.
card.fullBodyText: When full=true, the card fills the screen width with no side gaps.

collapse.title: Collapse
collapse.subtitle: Collapse panels to organize content areas, supporting accordion/non-accordion modes, custom styles and nested folding.
collapse.basicDesc: In non-accordion mode, multiple panels can be expanded at the same time; tap the title to toggle.
collapse.basicItem1Body: As long as we choose an appropriate reference point, worthy things will come into view.
collapse.basicItem2Head: Beauty is everywhere, but not everyone sees it
collapse.basicItem2Body: Learning to appreciate is a positive attitude towards life, a seasoning of life.
collapse.basicItem3Head: Ordinary people and things may hide extraordinary wisdom
collapse.basicItem3Body: It is said that the marble used for David was criticized by many sculptors.
collapse.accordionDesc: When accordion=true, only one panel is expanded at a time; expanding another collapses the current one.
collapse.accordionItem1Head: Ignite the flame in your heart
collapse.accordionItem1Body: He flipped through a few pages and was attracted by a novel titled Childhood.
collapse.accordionItem2Head: Because of appreciation, the stone became a sculpture
collapse.accordionItem2Body: Appreciation is a kind of understanding and trust, containing affirmation and appreciation.
collapse.initialDesc: Set the initial expanded state of a panel via the open prop.
collapse.initialItem1Body: This panel has open=true, so it is expanded when the page loads.
collapse.initialItem2Body: This panel has no open set, it is collapsed by default; tap the title to expand.
collapse.customDesc: Customize the panel title content via the title slot.
collapse.customBody: The title slot allows full customization of the panel title display.
collapse.disabledDesc: A panel with disabled=true cannot be expanded or collapsed by tapping.
collapse.disabledBody: This panel has disabled=true, tapping the title has no effect.
collapse.customStyleDesc: Customize the panel look via itemStyle, headStyle and bodyStyle; arrowColor sets the arrow color.
collapse.customStyleItem1Body: itemStyle adds a border, radius and margin to each panel.
collapse.customStyleItem2Body: headStyle sets the head background, bodyStyle sets the content padding.
collapse.nestedDesc: ux-collapse supports nesting: place another ux-collapse inside an outer panel, two levels expand independently and the outer height adapts automatically.
collapse.nestedOuterBody: Outer content: a group of inner collapse panels is nested below.
collapse.nestedInnerBody1: Inner content 1: tapping the inner title expands independently without affecting the outer state.
collapse.nestedInnerBody2: Inner content 2: the outer container height adapts as the inner panels expand/collapse.

grid.title: Grid
grid.subtitle: Grid is used to display multiple similar items at once, with configurable columns, borders and alignment.
grid.basicDesc: 3 columns by default; tapping a grid item triggers the click event with its index.
grid.colDesc: Set the number of columns via the col prop; here it is 4 columns.
grid.noBorderDesc: Hide the grid border via border=false.
grid.alignDesc: Set the grid alignment via the align prop; here it is centered.

loadmore.title: Loadmore
loadmore.subtitle: Used for loading state at the bottom of the page, supporting loadmore/loading/nomore states.
loadmore.basicDesc: When status=loadmore, clicking triggers the loadmore event.
loadmore.loadingDesc: When status=loading, shows loading animation and text.
loadmore.nomoreDesc: When status=nomore, shows no more data message.
loadmore.dotDesc: When is-dot=true, nomore state shows a dot.
loadmore.customDesc: Customize text and icon color via color and icon-color.

slider.title: Slider
slider.subtitle: Slider for selecting a value within a range, supporting step, custom range and colors.
slider.basicDesc: Bind value via v-model; drag the thumb or tap the bar to change.
slider.rangeDesc: Set range via start/end, step via step; here -50 to 50 with step 5.
slider.valueDesc: When show-value=true, display the current value above the thumb.
slider.positionDesc: value-position moves the current value below the track; show-edge-value=true prints the start/end values at both ends. These labels are out of flow, so the component reserves the space for them and they never overlap neighbouring elements.
slider.colorDesc: Customize progress bar colors via active-color and inactive-color.
slider.disabledDesc: When disabled=true, the slider cannot be dragged.

steps.title: Steps
steps.subtitle: Steps component for showing multiple stages of an operation process.
steps.dotDesc: Default dot mode, horizontal layout; use current to set the active step.
steps.numberDesc: mode=number shows numeric indices; completed steps display a check icon.
steps.verticalDesc: direction=column for vertical layout; use desc for descriptions.
steps.colorDesc: Customize active and inactive colors via active-color and inactive-color.
steps.controlDesc: Combine with buttons to control current value for step navigation.

swipeAction.title: SwipeAction
swipeAction.subtitle: Swipe left to reveal action menu, commonly used for swipe-to-delete.
swipeAction.basicDesc: Swipe left on content to reveal delete button; click triggers click event.
swipeAction.multiDesc: Configure multiple buttons via options array with custom colors and text.
swipeAction.controlDesc: Control open/close via show prop or ref open/close methods.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.subtitle: Pagination for data page navigation, supporting icon/text buttons and custom styles.
pagination.basicDesc: Bind current page via v-model; total and page-size calculate total pages.
pagination.iconDesc: show-icon displays left/right arrow icon buttons.
pagination.textDesc: Customize button text via prev-text and next-text.
pagination.customDesc: Customize pagination container style via custom-style.
pagination.eventDesc: Listen to change event for pagination direction and current page.

subsection.title: Subsection
subsection.subtitle: Subsection for selecting one option from several, supporting button and subsection modes.
subsection.buttonDesc: Default button mode; slider moves between buttons.
subsection.subsectionDesc: mode=subsection for segmented mode with borders between options.
subsection.colorDesc: Customize active and inactive colors via active-color and inactive-color.
subsection.customDesc: Combine font-size, height, bg-color, button-color for custom appearance.
subsection.disabledDesc: Set disabled=true to disable the whole component; a single item with disabled:true becomes unclickable.

textarea.title: Textarea
textarea.subtitle: Textarea for multi-line text input, supporting count, auto-height, border, etc.
textarea.basicDesc: Bind content via v-model; border=surround for all-side border.
textarea.countDesc: count=true shows character count; maxlength limits max length.
textarea.autoDesc: auto-height=true adjusts height based on content.
textarea.disabledDesc: disabled=true disables input with gray background.

actionSheet.title: ActionSheet
actionSheet.subtitle: Action sheet that pops up from the bottom for selecting from options.
actionSheet.basicDesc: Configure options via list; click triggers click event.
actionSheet.tipsDesc: Set top tip text via the tips prop.
actionSheet.subTextDesc: List items can set subText for description.
actionSheet.disabledDesc: Set disabled=true on list item to disable click.
actionSheet.noCancelDesc: cancel-btn=false hides the bottom cancel button.
actionSheet.subText1: Take a new photo with camera

picker.title: Picker
picker.subtitle: Picker with all data passed in externally, supporting single, multi and cascade modes.
picker.selectorDesc: mode=selector, pass one column via columns.
picker.cascadeDesc: mode=cascade, use children tree data for region linkage.

select.title: Select
select.subtitle: Column selector for single, multi and cascade selection scenarios.
select.singleDesc: mode=single-column, pass a 1D array via list.
select.multiDesc: mode=mutil-column, pass a 2D array via list.

numberBox.title: NumberBox
numberBox.subtitle: Stepper for shopping quantity selection, supporting step, range limits and disabled.
numberBox.basicDesc: Bind value via v-model; modify by tapping +/- or manual input.
numberBox.stepDesc: Set the increment/decrement via the step prop; here it is 10.
numberBox.rangeDesc: Limit min and max values via min and max props; here 5-50.
numberBox.disabledDesc: When disabled=true, all operations are disabled.
numberBox.sizeDesc: Customize size via size, input-width, input-height props.

cell.title: Cell
cell.subtitle: Cells are commonly used in list groups such as profile and settings pages, paired with ux-cell-group.
cell.basicDesc: Wrap ux-cell-item with ux-cell-group; title is the left label and value is the right content.
cell.groupDesc: Set the group title via the title prop of ux-cell-group.
cell.iconDesc: Set the left icon via the icon prop; only built-in icons are supported.
cell.labelDesc: Set the description below the title via the label prop.
cell.requiredDesc: Show a required asterisk on the left via the required prop.
cell.arrowDesc: Set the arrow direction via arrow-direction; arrow=false hides the arrow.
cell.widthDesc: Set the title width via title-width in px.
cell.clickDesc: Clicking a cell triggers the click event; index identifies which cell was clicked.
cell.hoverDesc: Customize the press feedback class via hover-class; the class must be defined by the consumer (page/global) with !important. Set to none to disable feedback.
cell.slotDesc: Customize the right content via the default slot and the left icon via the icon slot.
cell.borderDesc: border of ux-cell-group controls the group outer border; border-top/border-bottom of ux-cell-item control per-item borders.
cell.customDesc: center controls vertical centering, bg-color sets the background, title-style/value-style/label-style style each area, and hover-class set to none disables the click feedback.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.subtitle: Checkboxes are used when multiple selections are needed, paired with ux-checkbox-group.
checkbox.basicDesc: Bind the selected name array with v-model; max limits the maximum number of selections.
checkbox.batchDesc: Select all / deselect all by modifying the bound value.
checkbox.shapeDesc: shape="square" is a square (3px small radius), shape="circle" is circular.
checkbox.sizeDesc: Supports small / default / large presets and custom values (in px); with a numeric size, the icon and label scale to 0.6 and 0.8 of it.
checkbox.colorDesc: Set the selected color via active-color, which overrides the group color.
checkbox.maxDesc: Limit the maximum number of selections via max; a toast appears when exceeded.
checkbox.disabledDesc: Disable a single checkbox via disabled, or disable all via the group's disabled.

radio.title: Radio
radio.subtitle: Radios are used when only one option can be selected, paired with ux-radio-group.
radio.basicDesc: Bind the selected value with v-model; only one can be selected within the same group.
radio.shapeDesc: shape="circle" is circular, shape="square" is a square (3px small radius).
radio.sizeDesc: Supports small / default / large presets and custom values (in px); with a numeric size, the icon and label scale to 0.6 and 0.8 of it.
radio.colorDesc: Set the selected color via active-color, which overrides the group color.
radio.disabledDesc: Disable a single radio via disabled, or disable all via the group's disabled.

search.title: Search
search.subtitle: Search component with common search box features, ready to use out of the box.
search.basicDesc: Supports v-model binding, monitors events via @change, @search, @custom, @clear.
search.shapeDesc: shape="square" is a small radius (4px, default), shape="round" is a capsule.
search.clearableDesc: clearabled controls the clear icon visibility, shown when focused and has content.
search.actionDesc: show-action controls the right search button, click triggers @custom event.
search.animationDesc: When animation is true, the action button expands on focus and collapses on blur.
search.alignDesc: input-align controls the horizontal alignment of input text.

swiper.title: Swiper
swiper.subtitle: Commonly used for navigation carousels, ad displays, etc., supporting multiple indicators, 3D effects and autoplay.
swiper.basicDesc: Autoplay and loop by default, with a rounded indicator at the bottom.
swiper.modeDesc: Switch between rect/dot/round/number indicators via the mode prop.
swiper.effect3dDesc: When effect3d=true, inactive items scale down with side margins for a 3D feel.
swiper.titleDesc: When title=true, the title field in the list data is overlaid at the bottom.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.subtitle: Tab component. When there are many tabs they can slide horizontally; when few, sliding can be disabled and the active tab auto-centers.
tabs.basicDesc: Scrollable by default, the active tab auto-centers and triggers a change event on click.
tabs.scrollDesc: When is-scroll=false tabs are evenly distributed and cannot slide.
tabs.colorDesc: Customize active/inactive text colors via active-color / inactive-color.
tabs.badgeDesc: The count field in list data displays a badge; is-dot switches to a dot.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.subtitle: Used to display avatars, such as in personal centers or user avatars in comment list pages.
avatar.basicDesc: Pass src to show an image avatar, supporting large/default/mini and custom sizes.
avatar.textDesc: Passing text shows the first character as a placeholder, with bg-color for the background.
avatar.squareDesc: shape="circle" is a full circle (default); shape="square" is a square with a 4px small radius. Image and text avatars each compare one tier.
avatar.sexDesc: When show-sex=true a gender icon appears at the top-right; man for male, woman for female.
avatar.levelDesc: When show-level=true a level icon appears at the bottom-right, with a customizable background.
avatar.badgeColorDesc: Customize the badge background via sex-bg-color / level-bg-color.
avatar.imgModeDesc: Set the image crop mode via img-mode: aspectFill keeps aspect ratio, scaleToFill stretches to fill.

rate.title: Rate
rate.subtitle: Used for satisfaction surveys, star ratings, etc. Supports sliding selection, half stars and custom styles.
rate.basicDesc: Click a star to rate; clicking the first star clears the rating.
rate.countDesc: Set the number of stars via count and star size via size.
rate.colorDesc: Customize selected/unselected colors via active-color / inactive-color.
rate.halfDesc: When allow-half=true, tap the left half of a star to select half a star (0.5) or the right half for a full star; tapping the first star's half or full clears the rating.
rate.disabledDesc: When disabled=true the component is not interactive and only displays the rating.
rate.colorsDesc: Use the colors array to display different colors by rating range.

image.title: Image
image.subtitle: An enhanced image component with fade-in animation, loading, error placeholder, radius and shape.
image.basicDesc: square (small radius 4px) by default; customize size via width / height. See the example below for shapes.
image.radiusDesc: shape controls the shape: square (small radius 4px, default) / circle (perfect circle); border-radius takes precedence as soon as it is set, and 0 gives a true sharp corner.
image.errorDesc: Shows an error placeholder icon on failure, customizable via error-icon.
image.modeDesc: mode controls crop/scale. Compare aspectFit (full view) vs aspectFill (fills container, crops overflow).
image.fadeDesc: fade controls the fade-in transition on load. Compare no animation vs 500ms fade-in.
image.bgDesc: bg-color sets the loading/error placeholder background. Defaults to the theme background; a failing image keeps the placeholder visible for easy comparison.
image.slotDesc: The error slot fully customizes the failure placeholder, or use loading-icon/error-icon for built-in icons. Left: custom; right: loading icon.

statusBar.title: StatusBar
statusBar.subtitle: For immersive status bar adaptation, automatically fills the system status bar height with customizable background.
statusBar.basicDesc: Transparent background by default, automatically occupies the system status bar height.
statusBar.demoText: Content area below the status bar
statusBar.bgDesc: Set the status bar background color via the background prop.

popup.title: Popup
popup.subtitle: A popup layer container supporting top, bottom, left, right and center directions for modals and messages.
popup.basicDesc: Tap a button to pop once from that direction; the popup lists the props that are in effect and the ones that are not.
popup.containerTip: Popup is just a container; you can put any custom content inside.
popup.groupBasicSub: mode decides which direction the layer comes from; inline puts it straight into the page flow.
popup.inlineDesc: mode=inline renders no mask and no overlay; the content joins the page flow directly, ideal for panels without a mask.
popup.inlineTip: Inline mode participates in page layout, so the wrapper has to provide a width.
popup.groupSizeSub: length is read as height or width depending on direction; center uses width + height; margin-top only nudges vertically.
popup.sizeDesc: Three entries: bottom drawer height, center fixed width/height, left drawer width; the popup echoes the effective and the inactive props.
popup.sizeTip: For bottom/top length is the height, for left/right it is the width; under center width applies and an empty height falls back to auto.
popup.radiusDesc: A border-radius above 0 makes the component add overflow:hidden to clip corners; bg-color lands on the popup root node; margin-top only applies to center.
popup.radiusTip: Only when the content area has no background can you see bg-color landing on the popup root node.
popup.groupMaskSub: mask decides whether the overlay renders, mask-close-able whether a tap closes, mask-custom-style restyles it, z-index lifts the stacking.
popup.maskDesc: Turning mask off removes the dimming under the popup; turning mask-close-able off means the mask no longer closes it - only the button or code does.
popup.maskTip: Without a mask the area outside the popup stays interactive - mind the gesture conflicts.
popup.maskStyleDesc: mask-custom-style customizes the mask with hyphenated keys, z-index lifts popup and mask together, height sets the popup height directly.
popup.groupCloseIconSub: closeable decides whether it shows; the four close-icon-* props decide glyph, position, color and size.
popup.closeDesc: The icon carries its own padded hit area (it reaches all the way to the popup corners) and sits at z-index 9 above the content.
popup.closePos: Close icon position (tap a button to pop from that corner)
popup.closeIconTip: The icon itself is the close entry - try all four corners and notice the hit area reaches the popup corners.
popup.closeOffTip: Icon hidden; only the mask or code can close it.
popup.groupSafeAnimSub: Safe area is applied as padding on the popup root node, so the content must touch the inner edge to be visible; duration/zoom shape the transitions.
popup.safeAreaDesc: Both are now on by default (default true): padding-bottom is added whenever the popup's bottom edge sits on the screen bottom (mode=bottom|left|right), padding-top avoids the status bar whenever the top edge sits on the screen top (mode=top|left|right), and center touches neither. This demo pins the button and the blue bar to the content end so the switch contrast is visible.
popup.safeEdgeTip: The adaptation only applies when the direction matches and the device safe area is greater than 0: toggle the switch and watch the blue bar move - PC and some emulators show no difference.
popup.safeBottomTip: Toggling the switch moves the button and the bar below it up by exactly one safe area height.
popup.safeTopTip: When on, the bar starts below the status bar; when off, it runs into the status bar.
popup.safeLeftTip: The drawer is 100% tall, so both of its edges touch the screen: the top yields the status bar and the bottom yields the safe area at the same time.
popup.noSafeArea: 0px (no safe area on this device, nothing to observe)
popup.durationDesc: duration controls the show/hide transition in ms; zoom only applies when mode=center.
popup.animTip: With zoom off only the translation remains; with it on the popup springs from 0.85 to 1.
popup.groupSlideSub: The drag bar and the content area are two independent paths sharing slide-down-threshold; scrollable content must pass scroll-id.
popup.slideDesc: Once rendered, the drag bar can always be pulled down to close; close-on-slide-down only governs the content-area path.
popup.slideTip: Drag bar only, content area never closes: show-drag-bar=true + close-on-slide-down=false; without scroll-id the content drag is taken over as a close and the list stops scrolling.
popup.scrollItemText: Swipe up to scroll; only pulling down after reaching the top triggers the close
popup.groupControlSub: before-close intercepts the component's own close actions; popup=false hands the write-back back to the parent.
popup.beforeDesc: Returning false (or Promise<false>) from before-close cancels the current close attempt: the first attempt below is intercepted, the second actually closes.
popup.beforeTip: The first close attempt gets intercepted
popup.beforeHint: Tap the close icon or the mask to dismiss: only the component's internal close paths go through before-close; writing v-model directly does not.
popup.controlledDesc: With popup=false the component only emits close and never writes v-model back, leaving the parent in charge (the contract nested consumers such as ux-select / ux-picker rely on).
popup.controlledTip: Tapping the close icon or the mask only emits close
popup.groupEventSub: Only two counters are kept to verify the event channel - no detailed logging.
popup.countDesc: opened = enter animation finished, closed = exit animation finished and the node unmounted; all popup instances share one pair. If the counters climb while the content layer stays invisible, the event channel is intact and the visibility channel is broken.

navbar.title: Navbar
navbar.subtitle: A top navigation bar supporting custom content, back events and gradient backgrounds.
navbar.basicDesc: Fixed at the top by default, with a back icon and centered title; supports a back text.
navbar.titleStyleDesc: Style the title via title-bold, title-size and title-color; title-width limits width with single-line ellipsis.
navbar.long: A long title that will be truncated with an ellipsis
navbar.backBarDesc: is-back controls back visibility; back-text, back-icon-name/size/color customize the back bar.
navbar.bgDesc: background supports linear gradient and solid color.
navbar.slotDesc: left / default / right slots to customize the left, center and right areas.
navbar.slotText: A light boat passes ten thousand mountains
navbar.customBackDesc: custom-back overrides the default back behavior for interception or custom logic.
navbar.backTip: Custom back triggered (not actually navigating back)
navbar.borderDesc: border-bottom controls the bottom border; height customizes the navbar height.
navbar.fixedDesc: is-fixed pins to top, immersive removes the fixed placeholder, z-index controls stacking.
navbar.fixedNote: The top navbar on this page is the is-fixed=true scenario. Demos use is-fixed=false to scroll with the page; on a real page top combine is-fixed=true, immersive to remove placeholder, and z-index for stacking.

modal.title: Modal
modal.subtitle: A modal dialog for message prompts and operation confirmations, with custom content and async close support.
modal.basicDesc: Tap the button to show a modal with customizable title, content and buttons.
modal.basicContent: This is a basic modal content for message prompts.
modal.customDesc: Customize the title, content and confirm/cancel button text.
modal.customContent: This is a custom modal where the title and button text can be customized.
modal.asyncDesc: With async-close=true, the confirm button shows a loading state and closing is controlled externally.
modal.asyncContent: After tapping confirm the button enters loading and auto-closes after 2 seconds.

toast.title: Toast
toast.subtitle: A lightweight toast notification supporting multiple themes, positions and auto navigation.
toast.basicDesc: Tap the button to show a success toast that auto-dismisses after 2 seconds.
toast.positionDesc: Supports top, center and bottom positions.
toast.iconDesc: Set icon=false to hide the icon.
toast.loadingDesc: Set loading=true to show a loading spinner.

alertTips.title: AlertTips
alertTips.subtitle: Displays information that needs attention, with success / warning / info / error themes; closable and customizable.
alertTips.basicDesc: Set the text via title; defaults to the warning theme and emits click when tapped.
alertTips.themeDesc: Configure success / warning / info / error via type; show-icon displays the matching icon.
alertTips.descDesc: With both title and description, the title is bolded automatically, suitable for multi-line messages.
alertTips.descText: A new version has been released with improvements and fixes. We recommend upgrading soon.
alertTips.closeDesc: close-able shows the close button and close-text customizes its label; closing only emits the close event, while show controls visibility from outside.
alertTips.closeTip: The file was uploaded to a temporary directory and will be cleaned up after confirmation.
alertTips.iconDesc: The icon property overrides the default theme icon; icon-style adjusts the icon style.
alertTips.styleDesc: color / bg-color / border-color override text, background and border colors; title-style / desc-style fine-tune each part.
alertTips.styleText: Background, border and text colors are all overridden, with customized title and description styles.

topTips.title: TopTips
topTips.subtitle: Slide a tip bar from the top via show(); it hides automatically, with navbar height adaptation and customizable z-index.
topTips.basicDesc: Call show() through the component ref; defaults to the primary theme and hides after 2 seconds.
topTips.themeDesc: show({ type }) supports primary / success / warning / error / info themes.
topTips.durationDesc: show({ duration }) controls how long the tip stays visible in milliseconds.
topTips.navDesc: navbar-height adapts to the page navbar height in px; z-index controls the stacking level.

keyboard.title: Keyboard
keyboard.subtitle: A custom keyboard panel with number / ID card / plate modes hosted in a bottom popup.
keyboard.numberDesc: The default number keyboard; dot-enabled controls the decimal point; tapping a key emits change and backspace fires on deletion.
keyboard.numberPh: Tap the button to open the keyboard
keyboard.cardDesc: Adds an X key on top of the number layout, suitable for ID card input.
keyboard.carDesc: A mixed layout of province abbreviations, letters and digits, suitable for license plates.
keyboard.customDesc: tips / cancel-text / confirm-text customize the toolbar labels; random shuffles the keys.
keyboard.switchDesc: tooltip hides the whole toolbar; show-tips / cancel-btn / confirm-btn control each element; mask / mask-close-able / dot-enabled control the mask and keys.
keyboard.flatDesc: safe-area-inset-bottom adapts to the bottom safe area; z-index customizes the popup level.

fullScreen.title: FullScreen
fullScreen.subtitle: A version-upgrade prompt covering the navbar and tabbar on App; it pops up once mounted, and both cancel and confirm navigate back.
fullScreen.basicDesc: Mounting the component pops it up automatically; the title falls back to the library default; cancel or confirm calls navigateBack.
fullScreen.basicContent: This update improves startup speed and fixes several known issues.
fullScreen.customDesc: Override the default title via title; content shows the upgrade details.
fullScreen.customContent: v1.1.0 adds multi-theme and dark mode support and improves rendering performance for large lists.
fullScreen.noteDesc: Note: show is forced to true after mounting (it pops up even when passed false); mount it on demand in your version-check logic.

configProvider.title: ConfigProvider
configProvider.subtitle: A config injection component that initializes and responds to theme, dark mode and locale changes, and passes theme CSS variables down to its root node.
configProvider.basicDesc: Wrapping content injects the theme CSS variables so children can use theme classes directly.
configProvider.basicText: Theme variables injected: background and text colors follow the global theme
configProvider.themeDesc: current-theme switches the theme name; initialization and changes call the global setTheme (affects the whole app).
configProvider.localeDesc: current-locale switches the locale name (e.g. zh-CN / en-US); the whole app follows.
configProvider.eventDesc: theme-change / mode-change fire when the theme or dark mode changes; the latest record is shown below.

indexHome.title: uView Pro X
indexHome.subtitle: A UI framework for rapid multi-platform development

indexConfig.addUnitDesc: Unit conversion utility supporting px, etc.
indexConfig.toStyleDesc: Convert objects to inline style strings
indexConfig.trimDesc: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from strings

tabbarMenu.maskDesc: Overlay layer for popup background blocking
tabbarMenu.overlayDesc: Mask layer built on v-if node creation plus a class-channel fade, the underlying implementation of the popup mask
tabbarMenu.transitionDesc: Transition animation, unified enter/leave effects wrapper
tabbarMenu.skeletonDesc: Skeleton screen placeholder for page loading
tabbarMenu.inputDesc: Input field supporting multiple types and sizes
tabbarMenu.cellDesc: Cell items for list group display
tabbarMenu.radioDesc: Radio supporting single selection within a group
tabbarMenu.searchDesc: Search box with clear, search, and custom events
tabbarMenu.cardDesc: Card with head/body/foot slots, rounded corners, shadow and border
tabbarMenu.avatarDesc: Avatar supporting image/text/gender and level badges
tabbarMenu.statusBarDesc: Status bar for immersive system status bar adaptation
tabbarMenu.stepsDesc: Steps with dot/number mode, horizontal/vertical, custom colors
tabbarMenu.swipeActionDesc: Swipe cell, swipe left to reveal action menu
tabbarMenu.paginationDesc: Pagination with icon/text buttons and custom styles
tabbarMenu.subsectionDesc: Subsection with button/subsection mode, animation, custom colors
tabbarMenu.actionSheetDesc: Action sheet, pops up options from bottom
tabbarMenu.pickerDesc: Picker with external data, supports single/multi/cascade
tabbarMenu.navbarDesc: Navbar supporting custom content/back events/gradient backgrounds
tabbarMenu.gapDesc: Spacer slot for separating content blocks
tabbarMenu.safeBottomDesc: Bottom safe area, adapted for devices like iPhone X
tabbarMenu.tagDesc: Tag supporting multiple types/shapes and closable
tabbarMenu.emptyDesc: Empty state with over ten built-in scene icons
tabbarMenu.lineProgressDesc: Linear progress bar supporting themes/stripes/custom colors
tabbarMenu.countDownDesc: Countdown supporting Chinese/colon separators and borders
tabbarMenu.circleProgressDesc: Ring progress supporting theme colors/custom size/dynamic progress
tabbarMenu.linkDesc: Link supporting multi-platform navigation and custom styles
tabbarMenu.layoutDesc: Grid layout, 12-column grid used with ux-row / ux-col
tabbarMenu.tabBarDesc: Bottom tab bar supporting icons/text/raised buttons
tabbarMenu.noNetworkDesc: No network prompt, auto-detect network status
tabbarMenu.addUnitDesc: Unit conversion utility supporting px, etc.
tabbarMenu.toStyleDesc: Convert objects to inline style strings
tabbarMenu.trimDesc: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from strings
tabbarMenu.alertTipsDesc: Alert tips with four closable themes
tabbarMenu.topTipsDesc: Top tip bar, shown via show() and hidden automatically
tabbarMenu.keyboardDesc: Custom keyboard: number / ID card / plate
tabbarMenu.fullScreenDesc: Full-screen upgrade prompt covering navbar and tabbar
tabbarMenu.configProviderDesc: Config provider for theme / dark mode / locale

tabbarComponents.title: Components
tabbarComponents.subtitle: uView Pro X UI Component Library
tabbarComponents.brandDesc: A multi-platform UI component library built on uni-app x: one codebase for App / H5 / Mini Program / HarmonyOS, vapor-mode-first rendering with style isolation 2.0, plus i18n, themes and dark mode.

tabbarAbout.title: About
tabbarAbout.subtitle: uView Pro X framework information
tabbarAbout.tagline: A UI framework for rapid multi-platform development
tabbarAbout.featureVaporDesc: Bytecode rendering on App, composition API and plain class selectors only
tabbarAbout.featureIsolationDesc: Component styles never leak into page backgrounds or text colors
tabbarAbout.featureLanguageDesc: Components and pages written in strongly typed UTS, TS / JS ecosystem compatible
tabbarAbout.featureThemeDesc: Multiple theme colors with system dark mode sync
tabbarAbout.featureLocaleDesc: Chinese / English texts switch at runtime
tabbarAbout.featureEasycomDesc: ux-* components work without manual import

demoHome.title: uView Pro X Demo
demoHome.subtitle: Demo pages for the component library's uni-app x migration
